body.x: Loky participated in the “CES 2018 Unveiled” which opened on Sunday, 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to present an excellent solution for data protection.

In 2016, 80% of French enterprises experienced a cyberattack at least once. And, previous antivirus programs were ineffective against “BadUSD” attack which occurred in 2014 in the aspect of the capacity of detecting computer viruses and the capacity of protecting the data from the viruses. Moreover, the users suffer very much from difficulties in data management due to problems related to control of access to the data, loss or theft of the data, damage to the data, etc.

In order to solve such problems, Lokly developed a solution which can safely transmit and save the data, and which is safe from BadUSD attacks. Designed and developed in France, this solution can protect the data in a safer and simpler way than previous antivirus programs.

CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
